name: Playgroup
description: A gentle first taste of school, where little ones settle in, make friends, and learn through play, song, and touch.

name: Nursery
description: First words, first numbers, and plenty of making things, all through structured play and steady daily routine.

name: Lower Kindergarten (LKG)
description: Readiness for real school, balancing early reading and numbers with art, movement, and a curious look at the world.

name: Upper Kindergarten (UKG)
description: The bridge into Class 1, growing writing, reading fluency, and the first joined-up thinking, without rushing childhood.

name: Primary, Class 1 to 3
description: The foundation years, taught for real understanding, in English and Hindi, with science that gets explored, not memorised.

name: Primary, Class 4 to 5
description: Academics grow more ambitious as children take on projects, work in teams, and begin to lead among their classmates.

name: Middle School, Class 6 to 8
description: Real depth in science and mathematics, plus room to lead, so a child leaves confident and well prepared for secondary school.
